prompts.royal: Production-quality 2.5D dark fantasy chess action game ENVIRONMENT BACKGROUND PLATE, landscape 16:10 composition. Elevated mild three-quarter camera looking onto a floor, not a vertical wall. Rich layered architectural/natural environment, expensive stylized painterly 3D-render materials, upper-left coherent soft light and deep gentle shadows. Camera horizon around upper quarter. A separate raised chessboard will be composited in the central-lower region, so NO CHESSBOARD, NO GRID, NO TILES OF A CHESS GAME, NO GAME CHARACTERS, NO UI, NO WORDS. Detailed themed side structures on outermost 20% left/right and elaborate rear architecture in upper 25%; central floor still richly textured but quiet low contrast, without objects that would intersect a game board spanning x22%-83%, y20%-88%. Include a broad low single dais in lower centre under the future board, not steps crossing play area; establish physical floor and fore/mid/background layers. Atmospheric premium arena, not a concept sketch. Avoid large bright red/orange/cyan light pools near central combat region. No giant empty black void. Royal Chess: grand ivory/black marble royal hall, matte gold metal ribs and restrained carved royal crests, fluted columns and small candle braziers framing the outer sides, distant throne and arches, deep navy ceiling shadows, burgundy carpet runners along outer edges and near foreground, gold-trimmed stone floor dais. Luxurious orderly space with muted ivory floor. Keep candles small.
